title: The regions discover read, one row each

status.description: The worst of the region's lists. ok: every list was read to its end; forbidden: the credential may not list something there (an SCP, a missing permission) and nothing else failed; failed: any other error, with a matching entry in the run's errors. A null count says which list

functions.description: Lambda functions in the region (0 for a region that was read and has none); null when that list could not be read

instances.description: EC2 instances in the region that are not terminated (0 for a region that was read and has none); null when that list could not be read

omitted.description: Regions left out of items by maxItems
